maria: Heads-up: prepping a short internal release note for the staging rollout today. Need a quick copy pass and confirm rollback triggers before I schedule the job. Target rollout 17:30 UTC. @sam @sylvia

maria: Draft RN (short):
```
Staging rollout (db-7243) — inference runtime tweaks and new quant profile. Expected benefits: ~15% median latency gain on long-context gen and marginal embedding token cost decrease. No API surface changes.
Canary: 10% for a 10m health window, then ramp to 100% if all checks pass.
Auto-rollback: revert to model-v1.9-quant on sustained error spike or if failure rate >3% for 5 minutes. Manual rollback allowed by oncall.
```

sam: Quick Q: do we want an intermediate 50% step? 10 -> 100 is fast but gives a quick signal.

maria: Prefer quick: 10% -> 100% after 10m. We want to surface regressions quickly and avoid long partial states.

deploy-bot: @maria scheduled job db-7243 for 2024-08-21T17:30:00Z. Status: pending. Will post stage updates here.

sylvia: Copy suggestion: change "inference runtime tweaks" to "inference kernel and quantization updates" and add a one-line on "internal-only announcement". Also add the verification step for engineers.

evan: I'll draft the internal announcement. Keep it concise: header + 3 bullets (what, verify, contacts). Put me down to post in #eng-releases when ready.

evan: Internal announcement draft:
```
Internal: staging rollout at 17:30 UTC (db-7243)
- What: inference kernel + quantization profile update. Expect ~15% median latency improvement on long-context generation and lower embedding cost.
- How to verify: check rollout dashboard p50/p95 and run a quick job: `curl -sS https://staging-api.redwood.internal/metrics | jq '.latency.p50'`.
- Rollback: automatic fallback to model-v1.9-quant if failure rate exceeds 3% sustained for 5m, or manual rollback by oncall.
Ping @oncall-lisa for issues.
```

oncall-lisa: I'll be on standby 17:15-18:00 UTC. Monitoring errors and latency. My manual rollback threshold: sustained 5xx >1% for 5m. Assigning myself to the run.

maria: Thanks. Making copy edits and setting the announcement as internal-only. Scheduling now. :white_check_mark:

sam: I'll monitor metrics during canary and be ready to help with rollback if the dashboards show regression.

sylvia: LGTM from comms. No customer-facing message today.

deploy-bot: db-7243 update: queued -> started at 2024-08-21T17:30:12Z. Posting progress in this thread.

maria: Closing the loop here. Will post if any rollback or unexpected behavior occurs.
